rating_vs_sentiment.dataset_structure: Amazon Polarity (Stanford SNAP) provides binary polarity labels (0=Negative [1-2 Stars], 1=Positive [4-5 Stars]). Neutral 3-star reviews are excluded to maximize signal-to-noise ratio.
rating_vs_sentiment.average_rating_note: Direct 1-5 numeric rating field is abstracted as binary polarity ground truth in this benchmark.
